title: Route BitMatrix::mul row-XOR through xor_fn dispatch
description:
Route `BitMatrix::mul` non-M4RM path through the existing AVX2 XOR kernel. V0→V3 jump in one hop — `LogicalFns::xor_fn` exists but the row accumulation in this path doesn't call it.

## Background

`BitMatrix::mul` non-M4RM path at `crates/gf2-core/src/matrix.rs:1165+` uses scalar inner-product per `(r,c)` pair. The AVX2 XOR kernel `LogicalFns::xor_fn` is registered via `gf2_core::simd::maybe_simd()` but the row-XOR accumulation here does not call it.

The fix: refactor the non-M4RM path so row-XOR accumulation goes through `simd::maybe_simd().xor_fn` for rows above a width threshold (reuse the threshold tuning approach from `m4rm_components.rs`). The M4RM path crossover is unchanged — this task touches the non-M4RM fallback only.

PPC walk: V0 baseline (`matmul` bench, pinned by I1) → V3 dispatch → asm verify (expecting `vpxor` mnemonic in the inner loop).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Existing matmul tests + word-boundary `#[test]`s pass at $n \in \{0, 1, 63, 64, 65, 127, 128, 129\}$.
- [hard] Proptest equivalence vs. scalar via the I4 helper.
- [hard] M4RM path crossover unchanged.
- [hard] Sibling `*.asm.txt` artefact shows `vpxor` in the dispatched call site.
- [hard] `perf stat -r 10` capture before/after recorded.
- [aspirational] $\geq 1.5\times$ geomean over baseline at the non-M4RM design size class. Below the bar: revert.

## Notes

Bench: `matmul` (existing, pinned by I1). Spec doc: `dev/plans/gf2_core_ppc_spiral.md`.
